targetAssumption: No integration target was chosen. The observed canonical checkout is not a safe merge base and must not be overwritten or used for an in-place merge.
safeIntegrationTemplateAfterMikeAccepts: Re-check the chosen target branch HEAD, worktree status, and whether it already contains the intake commit.
Create a new clean review worktree from <mike-selected-target-ref>; do not use the busy canonical checkout.
In the review worktree run: git merge --no-ff --no-commit <final-source-commit>.
Inspect the complete staged diff, rerun every required and focused check, and let Mike decide whether to create the merge commit.
